zh-CN.name: 赛博朋克 UI
zh-CN.description: 通过深色背景、霓虹强调、技术化图形与都市科幻意象表达赛博朋克氛围。它是主题化视觉，不要求闪烁、故障文字或持续 HUD 动画。
use_when: 娱乐、游戏或科技品牌有明确的主题表达。
少量霓虹强调可以帮助区分信息层级。
avoid_when: 高饱和光效不宜覆盖正文和密集数据。
不要用频繁闪烁表达重要状态。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
使用深色表面和有限霓虹强调，把科幻图形放在装饰层；正文、状态与主操作保持高可读性；重要变化用文字和稳定状态表达，故障与闪烁效果可关闭且不影响任务。
专属演示：深色技术面板、切角边界与霓虹强调；单次本地扫描更新明确状态，无闪烁循环。 参数：强调色 {accent}；演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Cyberpunk UI
en.description: A themed visual direction using dark backgrounds, neon accents, technical graphics and urban science-fiction imagery. It does not require flicker, glitch text or continuously animated HUD elements.
use_when: Entertainment, games or a technology brand has a clear thematic intent.
Selective neon accents can reinforce hierarchy.
avoid_when: Intense glow should not cover body text or dense data.
Do not use frequent flicker to communicate important states.
en.prompt_template:
Use dark surfaces with limited neon accents and keep science-fiction graphics in decorative layers. Preserve readable text, states and actions. Communicate important changes through text and stable cues; any glitch or flicker treatment must be optional and nonessential.
Dedicated demonstration: A dark technical panel, clipped edges and neon accents; one local scan updates an explicit status without flashing loops. Parameters: accent color {accent}; demo duration {duration_ms}ms.
